lang.flashlights.warntext:
Hey, watch out!

		This Mod contains some flashing lights!

		Press ENTER to disable them now or go to Options Menu.

		Press ESCAPE to ignore this message.

		You've been warned!
lang.woodycutscene.benny2: I didn't even know I could do that...
lang.woodycutscene.benny3: I'm getting the hang of this!
lang.credits.bennation: Director, Programmer, Composer, Voice Actor for Benny and Main Artist
lang.credits.gi: Voice Actor for Gi, Compositor e Artista
lang.credits.joojdumwell: Voice Actor for Popcorn, Additional Voice and Composer
lang.credits.nebulazorua:
Modchart backend
(Created the initial fork NMV was derived from)
lang.notes.quantsenabled.text: Colors notes in-game based on their step value. Helpful for timing your note hits.
lang.notes.notesplashes.text: If unchecked, hitting "Sick!" notes won't show particles.
lang.notes.opponentnotes.text: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
lang.graphics.gpucaching.text: If checked, GPU caching will be enabled.
lang.graphics.lowquality.text:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.
lang.graphics.shaders.text: If checked, shaders will be enabled across the mod
lang.graphics.antialiasing.text:
If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance
at the cost of sharper visuals.
lang.graphics.timebar.text: What should the Time Bar display?
lang.graphics.debugdisplaytype.text:
Handles what type of information to display in the top left of your screen.
Simple displays FPS & Memory, and advanced displays the same alongside debug information.
Disabled disables the counter entirely.
lang.visuals.subtitles.text: If unchecked, disables all text subtitles in cutscenes or songs.
lang.visuals.hidehud.text: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
lang.visuals.showratings.text: If checked, rating graphics will appear on your HUD.
lang.visuals.healthbaralpha.text: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
lang.visuals.underlaytype.text: What should the lane underlay do?
lang.visuals.underlayalpha.text: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
lang.visuals.scoretext.text:
If unchecked, disables the Score text zooming
everytime you hit a note.
lang.visuals.camerazooms.text: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
lang.visuals.flashinglights.text: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
lang.visuals.jumpghosts.text: If unchecked, disables characters playing a 'ghost' animation on jumps.
lang.visuals.cameranotefollow.text: If unchecked, hitting notes will no longer have the camera follow in its direction.
lang.gameplay.mechanics.text: Check this if you want to enable mechanics!
lang.gameplay.modcharts.text: Check this if you want to enable modcharts!
lang.gameplay.downscroll.text: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.
lang.gameplay.ghosttapping.text:
If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys
while there are no notes able to be hit.
lang.gameplay.disablereset.text: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
lang.gameplay.hitsoundvolume.text: Funny notes does "Tick!" when you hit them.
lang.gameplay.ratingoffset.text:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!"
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
lang.gameplay.epicratings.text: If checked, adds Epic Ratings as a bonus judgement above sick (does not affect accuracy, only your score).
lang.gameplay.hitwindow1.text:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a
lang.gameplay.safeframes.text:
Changes how many frames you have for
hitting a note earlier or late.
lang.misc.nmvsplash.text: If unchecked, it will completely skip the splash screen upon the engine's boot up.
lang.misc.devmode.text: If checked, traces & developer hotkeys will become available.
lang.misc.streamedsongfiles.text: If checked, playable song files will be streamed via bytes instead of being loaded all at once. This heavily improves loading times, however it is EXTREMELY EXPERIMENTAL and prone to issues.
lang.misc.autopause.text: If checked, the game will automatically freeze when unselected, pausing all sounds and visuals. If unchecked, the game will continue as normal regardless of focus.
